score: Complete-stay ICU-relative SOFA in eight-hour blocks

adaptations.description: Uses non-overlapping eight-hour intervals anchored exactly at raw icustays.intime; block 0 is (intime,intime+8h], with a final partial block ending at outtime.
Emits every block through raw ICU outtime without a day cap. Stays with null or nonpositive outtime are excluded because a complete-stay endpoint cannot be established.
Computes standard SOFA from the worst component values in the exact chronological interval (block_end-24h,block_end], including the omitted leading segment for a partial discharge block.
Retains nullable rolling component scores in *_24hours_raw while preserving upstream COALESCE(component,0) behavior in the reported components and total.
Scores only positive vasoactive rates from recorded episodes lasting at least one hour and overlapping a block.
Retains GCS components, PaO2 and effective FiO2, and urine volume and duration from the observation selected within each current eight-hour block.

preserved_upstream_behavior: The reported SOFA at each block end uses a trailing 24-hour component window, not only the current eight-hour block.
Event intervals use starttime < charttime and endtime >= charttime.
Urine output accepts a urine-output-rate window only when uo_tm_24hr is between 22 and 30 hours and scales it to 24 hours.
Arterial blood gases only are used for respiratory SOFA and ventilation status is evaluated at blood-gas charttime.
Missing rolling components contribute zero to sofa_trailing_24h; missingness is exported separately.
